zh: 这是我的赛博永生工作室。一个把脑洞、作品和朋友，慢慢装进去的小世界。
这里的猫会招手，作品会悬浮。而造出这个世界，要从一张图开始。
我先准备造型参考，再交给 Tripo AI。图片或文字，就这样变成可以旋转查看的三维模型。
上传，生成，检查，再导出 GLB。这四步把灵感变成资产，接下来才是搭建空间。
如果你也想试试，免费版每月二百点，Pro 月付二十美元。API 另外计费，先探索再选方案。
拿到模型之后，我用 Blender 调整比例和摆放，再用 Three.js 加入灯光与交互。工作室就这样亮了起来。
空间搭好了，就装进真正做过的东西：机器人、灵巧手，还有黑客松项目。这里会持续更新。
但这里不只属于我。绕到背面，留下照片、留言或愿望。审核之后，你的脚印也会成为这里的记忆。
想让这个世界继续生长，也欢迎品牌加入。头顶的广告牌，留给核心、硬件和社区赞助商。
核心赞助按页轮播，十秒、八秒、五秒。五十元每月起，标志跳转官网，确认后按档期展示。
除了广告牌，硬件品牌还能走进车间。比如普劳德 NotePin S，用赛博展位连接真实使用和后续测评。
对我这种想法总在乱飞的人，记录只是起点。我计划用它收集会议和灵感，再借助 AI 整理需求与开发规格，交给编程工具。这会是接下来的实测。
硬件支持创作，社区把人聚在一起。活动、展位、周边都能来聊，Makers Challenge 也在寻找伙伴。
想一起参与，就从广告牌提交申请。我会确认合作内容和档期，现阶段先人工沟通，再安排上架。
所以，这里既是作品档案，也是一间邀请你参与的工作室。来逛逛，留下脚印，下一件我们一起造。
en: This is my Cyber Eternal Studio. A little world for my ideas, my projects, and the people I meet.
The cat waves. Projects float. But building this world began with a single image.
I give Tripo A I a reference image or a text prompt. An idea becomes a three-dimensional model.
Upload, generate, inspect, and export a GLB. Now the idea is an asset, ready to become part of a place.
Want to try? Start free with two hundred monthly credits. Pro is twenty US dollars monthly. The API is billed separately.
Next, I arrange scale and placement in Blender. Three.js adds light and interaction. The workshop comes alive.
With a place built, I fill it with real work: robots, dexterous hands, and build challenges. More projects will follow.
This place is yours too. Go around the back. Leave a photo, message, or wish. Approved visits become shared memories.
To help this world grow, brands can join us. The neon billboard welcomes core, hardware, and community sponsors.
Core sponsors rotate across three pages: ten, eight, and five seconds. From fifty Chinese yuan monthly. Clickable logos. Confirmed campaigns follow a schedule.
Beyond the billboard, products can enter the workshop. A NotePin S booth connects a digital showcase with real use and future reviews.
My ideas scatter easily. Recording is only the start. I plan to capture meetings and ideas, then use A I to turn them into requirements and a development plan. That is the next workflow to test.
Hardware supports making. Community brings people together. Share an event, booth, or swag. Our Makers Challenge proposal is seeking partners.
To join in, apply through the billboard. We agree on the collaboration and dates, then schedule your campaign. For now, we arrange payment manually.
This is an archive of my work, and an invitation to take part. Explore, leave a trace, and build the next thing with me.
